description: Source code implementing ETC1 texture compression and decompression functions, including encoding/decoding blocks and entire images, as well as PKM header formatting and validation.

methods.name: etc1_encode_block
methods.description: Encodes a 4x4 pixel block into ETC1 compressed format.

methods.name: etc1_decode_block
methods.description: Decodes an ETC1 compressed 4x4 block into pixel data.

methods.name: etc1_encode_image
methods.description: Encodes an entire image into ETC1 format.

methods.name: etc1_decode_image
methods.description: Decodes ETC1 compressed data into an image.

methods.name: etc1_pkm_format_header
methods.description: Formats a PKM header for ETC1 texture data.

methods.name: etc1_pkm_is_valid
methods.description: Validates a PKM header for ETC1 texture data.

methods.name: etc1_pkm_get_width
methods.description: Retrieves image width from PKM header.

methods.name: etc1_pkm_get_height
methods.description: Retrieves image height from PKM header.
